Title: Cancelling a deleted active HD Prescription

Step Action: Log in to the app with user “support” and password “renal”
Click on “Accept” button
At the top in the “-Select a patient-“ listbox, select "Paciente136"
On the main menu select “HD Prescription”
In the prescription dates list in “Prescription History”, the last active one is pre-selected
Click on “Delete” option
Click on “Cancel” popup button
The system shall not delete HD Prescription

Title: Delete Active HD Prescription (empty reason or wrong password)

Step Action: Log in to the app with user “support” and password “renal”
Click on “Accept” button
At the top in the “-Select a patient-“ listbox, select "Paciente136"
On the main menu select “HD Prescription”
In the prescription dates list in “Prescription History”, the last active one is pre-selected
Click on “Delete” option
Click on “OK” popup button
Warning: Password and Reason are required
Type any text on “Reason” and “Password” text boxes
Click on “OK” popup button
Warning: Password entered is incorrect
The system shall not delete the HD Prescription
